name: Nikkō Kanaya Hotel
scope: Standing Nikkō Kanaya Hotel above Hachiishi-machi, including the 1893 Main Building with its 1936 stone ground floor, New Building, 1935 Annex and 1961 Second New Building.
era: Standing Nikkō Kanaya Hotel, including surviving buildings from 1893 through 1961.

originalReview.notes: Archival albumen photograph records the early hotel’s surviving timber architecture, two upper levels, shallow hip, clapboards, sash and shutters, balconies, deep cornice and timber carriage shelter. The street-level stone structure comes from later heritage documentation.

review.method: Qualla-first screening and primary public-domain Rijksmuseum original.
review.notes: Screened the published Qualla media first. The coffee pot is outside scope and the circa-1900 Qualla hotel rendition has unclear original provenance. Native Rijksmuseum photograph RP-F-F01102-BH has an explicit public-domain mark and provides independent period evidence.
